query:
INSERT INTO chat_repositories (chat_id, repository_id)
           SELECT $1, r.id
           FROM repositories r
           WHERE r.id IN (SELECT unhex(value, '-') FROM json_each($3))
             AND (r.user_id = $2
                  OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM repository_users ru WHERE ru.repository_id = r.id AND ru.user_id = $2))
